english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person hired to show visitors around and explain a place.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who guides and provides information on an organised tour.

examples.english: This guide explains everything very clearly.
examples.traditional: 呢個導遊講解得好清楚。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 dou6 jau4 gong2 gaai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

examples.english: The tour guide explained everything very clearly on this trip.
examples.traditional: 今次旅行團嘅導遊講解得好清楚。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 tyun4 ge3 dou6 jau4 gong2 gaai2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2
